title: The River Between Them

actions.label: Send word across to Castañeda himself.
actions.detail: The ranchos have a cousin in Béxar. He is a federalist. He may not want this either.

strong.narrate: Word comes back. He says he is himself a federalist. He says he does not approve of what Santa Anna has done to the Constitution. He says he has his orders. Sit with that.
strong.broadcast: {name} got an answer from across the river. Castañeda is a federalist too.

partial.narrate: Word comes back that he has his orders and regrets the necessity. He means both halves of that.

weak.narrate: The messenger is turned back at the water. Whatever he would have said, you will not hear it.

actions.label: Cross the river in the fog and find their camp.
actions.detail: Before dawn, before anyone can see you do it.

strong.narrate: A hundred dragoons, cold, and not expecting anybody. You could count their fires. You come back knowing exactly what this town is facing.

partial.narrate: You find them. You are not sure they did not find you first.

weak.narrate: The fog is thicker than the plan was. You come back wet and no wiser.

actions.label: Make the flag.
actions.detail: Somebody in this town is going to. Nobody has said who.

strong.narrate: A cannon, a star, and four words. The whole town sees it go up and something in the square changes. Remember that YOU made it — because the story that will be told about who made it is not going to be about you.
strong.broadcast: {name} made the flag, and it went up over the cannon.

partial.narrate: It is crude and it is hurried and it flies.

weak.narrate: Somebody mocks the lettering. It flies anyway, which is the only thing about it that matters.

actions.label: Find something to fire out of a cannon with no shot.
actions.detail: There is no ball for it. There never was.

strong.narrate: Scrap iron, chain, nails, and a broken plough share, cut to length. It is not artillery. It will do exactly once and everybody knows it.

partial.narrate: Enough for one load if nobody looks too closely at what is in it.

weak.narrate: You spend an hour on it and produce a bucket of metal that may burst the barrel.

actions.label: Read what Austin is writing now, and what he wrote before.
actions.detail: Two letters, one man, and eighteen months in a Mexican prison between them.

all.narrate: He spent years telling colonists to stay loyal, obey the law, and avoid a war. Now he writes that war is the only recourse. Ask yourself what changed — the situation, or the man.

actions.label: Make sure every boat on this river is on our side of it.
actions.detail: A hundred dragoons and no way across is a different problem than a hundred dragoons.

strong.narrate: Every boat, every ferry, every skiff, on this bank and guarded. The river is now doing more work than the eighteen men are.

partial.narrate: Most of them. There is a skiff somewhere downstream you never found.

weak.narrate: You get wet, and two boats are still on the wrong bank at first light.

actions.label: Draft what this town says when the shooting starts.
actions.detail: Somebody has to justify this, in writing, before it happens.

strong.narrate: Loyal citizens of Mexico, defending the Constitution of 1824 against a government that has abandoned it. Every word of that is arguable and every word of it is what they believed.

partial.narrate: It says what they are fighting for. It is vaguer than you wanted about who they are fighting.

weak.narrate: It reads like a declaration of independence, which is not what anybody in this square has agreed to yet.

actions.label: Count how many have ridden in since the couriers went out.
actions.detail: Eighteen was the number a week ago.

all.narrate: About a hundred and eighty, from Mina and Bastrop and the Colorado. The couriers worked. Every one of those men rode here because somebody in this town got on a horse.

actions.label: Ask, out loud, what exactly is worth this.
actions.detail: It is a small bad cannon and there are a hundred men across the water.

strong.narrate: You get an honest answer from three people and none of them agree. That is the truest thing that will be said in this town today.
strong.broadcast: {name} asked what exactly this is worth, and got three different answers.

partial.narrate: Two people answer and one of them is only saying it to end the question.

weak.narrate: You are told this is not the moment. The sun is coming up.

actions.label: Stand at the water and watch the fog.
actions.detail: You have done your part. This is the last quiet hour.

all.narrate: Somewhere in that whiteness are a hundred men who would rather be somewhere else, commanded by a man who agrees with you about the Constitution. In about an hour you will not be able to think about them that way.

actions.label: Sit with the boats so nobody takes one back.
actions.detail: Somebody in this town still wants to talk instead.

all.narrate: Nobody crosses. You are not sure, afterwards, whether that was the right thing to have prevented.

actions.label: Sit with the youngest ones before dawn.
actions.detail: Sixteen and seventeen, and they have not slept.

all.narrate: You do not tell them it will be fine. You sit there, which is the only honest thing available.

actions.label: Empty your pockets into the cannon.
actions.detail: Nails, chain, broken hinges. One load, and then it is gone.

all.narrate: It is not shot and it was never meant to be. It is what the town has, and the town is what is loading it.
all.broadcast: The gun goes in loaded with scrap iron.

clock: the small hours — there is a moon
